summary: Iteration 5 focused testing of the 5 new features (Add modals for Accounts/Sites/Categories, Rules modal, Transaction detail drawer with edit + receipt upload, Transactions filters wired to GET /api/transactions, Reports month-close toggle) plus a regression sweep. All 10 nav links present. Backend endpoints (POST accounts/sites/categories/rules, PATCH transactions, POST documents, GET documents, POST month-close, GET transactions with filters) return 200 via curl. Playwright end-to-end: every new UI flow passes including modal-close-on-save, drawer save+persist (row site cell updated from 'Unassigned' to picked site 'Green Valley'), file attach shows up in doc list without reload, and Reports Close/Reopen month toggle flips label correctly.

issues: Recharts prints a benign console warning on first render: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart still renders once container sizes. Non-blocking, could be silenced by setting min-height on .chart-panel .chart.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js: MASTER_FIELDS driven modal is clean and DRY across accounts/sites/categories. Duplicate site_code will surface as an unhelpful alert (default SQLite UNIQUE error text via HTTPException chain — currently propagates as JSON default detail). Consider a friendlier 400 message on IntegrityError in POST /api/sites and POST /api/categories.
Transactions.loadRows re-fires on every filter keystroke (search) — fine for local SQLite but could be debounced.
TransactionDrawer PATCH endpoint returns the updated row but the frontend re-fetches the full list via loadRows(); acceptable and simple.

Reports.closeMonth does not read persisted state on mount — 'closed' always starts as false even if backend has the month closed. Minor UX issue: refreshing Reports loses the toggle state. Consider GET /api/month-close?year&month or including it in /reports/summary.
server.py month_closings table is created but never read anywhere — closed state is write-only. Same point as above.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ prefixed records (accounts, sites ZT####, categories, rules) directly via Playwright; can be removed via Backup & restore > Delete sample data if needed (they do not carry the demo notes flag so they will persist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new-feature review items pass. Only follow-up worth noting: Reports 'Close month' toggle is one-way persistent server-side but the client component does not hydrate the closed state on mount — the label always starts 'Close month'. Not in scope for this iteration but worth wiring in a future pass.
